answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in sparrow and onyx lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the tundra graph. Verification costs 18 dollars and 6 days per identity, which turns a 945 account sybil into a 2 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
